name: Spike
description_en: Spike combines conversational email with shared work: notes, tasks, groups, calls and AI-assisted inbox tools. Its Email App connects existing mail accounts; Teamspace adds hosted business email and organizational administration. A team should choose that service boundary before comparing plans or sharing a customer mailbox.
description_zh: Spike 把对话式邮件与共享工作结合，提供笔记、任务、群组、通话及 AI 收件箱工具。Email App 连接现有邮箱；Teamspace 则增加托管企业邮件和组织管理。团队应先选定服务边界，再比较套餐或共享客户邮箱。

sections.title_en: Decide whether to connect mail or operate new hosted mail
sections.title_zh: 先确定连接邮箱还是使用新托管邮件
sections.en:
Suppose a small agency wants a conversational view of existing client correspondence and a shared support address. Connecting the existing account through Email App is a different decision from creating hosted Teamspace mail. External email recipients still receive ordinary email; adopting Spike’s interface does not require every correspondent to install it.

Teamspace supplies an organizational workspace, business-email hosting and administration. Its setup guide has an admin choose the name, domain and username, then verify access using a phone code. That process does not establish that a current custom domain or old mailbox has already migrated. First document which provider holds the mail, who controls the domain and which identity is authoritative for the shared address. No account, code, mailbox or domain was created.
sections.zh:
假设小型机构希望以对话形式处理既有客户邮件，并共享支持地址。通过 Email App 连接现有账户，与新建托管 Teamspace 邮件是不同决定。外部收件者仍收到普通邮件，采用 Spike 界面不要求所有通信对象都安装它。

Teamspace 提供组织工作区、企业邮件托管及管理。设置指南由管理员选择名称、域名及用户名，再用手机验证码验证访问；这不证明现有自定义域名或旧邮箱已经迁移。应先记录由哪个服务商保存邮件、谁控制域名，以及共享地址的权威身份。本研究未创建账户、验证码、邮箱或域名。

sections.title_en: Assignment gives responsibility; access is a separate grant
sections.title_zh: 分配确定责任，访问需另行授权
sections.en:
The shared-inbox page limits the feature to Team and Business plans. A Teamspace owner/admin controls which members can access each mailbox; participants can assign emails and track work with status labels. Its connection instructions require the relevant Teamspace account, then adding the full shared-inbox address under account settings. A unified personal inbox is not equivalent to a shared organizational mailbox.

For the proposed support request, grant the intended people access, assign a responsible responder and inspect the reply identity before sending. Assignment is not evidence of a lock preventing two simultaneous replies, an enforced response deadline or a complete ticketing audit. Those behaviors were not demonstrated. Define the handoff and escalation procedure, and test member removal before using actual customer mail. This workflow was researched from public pages only.
sections.zh:
共享收件箱页面将功能限于 Team 和 Business。Teamspace 所有者／管理员控制各成员对每个邮箱的访问，参与者可分配邮件并用状态标签跟进。连接说明要求先使用相应 Teamspace 账户，再在账户设置添加完整共享邮箱地址；个人统一收件箱不等于组织共享邮箱。

在假设支持请求中，应先向目标人员授权，再分配回复负责人，发送前检查发件身份。分配不证明系统会锁定重复回复、强制响应时限，或提供完整工单审计；这些行为未演示。使用真实客户邮件前，应定义交接与升级流程，并测试成员移除。本流程仅据公开页面研究。

sections.title_en: Check Note permissions and save state independently
sections.title_zh: 分别检查笔记权限与保存状态
sections.en:
The notes guide describes sharing by email or link, including collaboration in a browser by non-Spike users. Can Edit permits editing, Can View restricts to reading, and Private denies other users access. A timestamped change list and inline comments support collaboration, but were not established as immutable audit or full-document restore.

For a proposed support diagnosis note, select the intended mode before sharing. If an orange offline bar says changes are not saved, the guide recommends copying recent content first, reopening or refreshing and pasting the copy if needed. Do not assume an open note or an apparently healthy internet connection means the latest edit reached the service. Preserve the local work before following the documented refresh path. No permission change, offline edit or recovery was performed.
sections.zh:
笔记指南描述通过邮件或链接共享，非 Spike 用户也可在浏览器协作。Can Edit 允许编辑，Can View 限于查看，Private 则拒绝其他用户访问。带时间的更改列表及行内评论辅助协作，但未确立为不可变审计或全文恢复机制。

假设编写支持诊断笔记，应先选定模式再共享。如果橙色离线条提示更改未保存，指南建议先复制近期内容，再重新打开或刷新，必要时粘贴副本。笔记仍开着或网络表面正常，不表示最新修改已到达服务。按文档刷新前，应先保留本地工作。本研究未执行权限变更、离线编辑或恢复。

sections.title_en: AI summaries and bulk actions need separate review
sections.title_zh: 分别审查 AI 摘要与批量操作
sections.en:
The composition guide generates text from a prompt plus format, tone and length; Use It inserts it into the composer before sending. For the proposed customer reply, compare names, commitments, dates and attachments against the actual conversation before approval. Generation is not evidence that the answer is correct or already sent.

AI Feed instead summarizes unread messages and offers mark-read, archive and trash actions, including bulk operations. Its explicit undo instructions concern marking messages read, with a brief banner. Do not treat that as a general guarantee that any deletion can be reversed. Read the source message when a summary could change a customer commitment, and evaluate bulk actions on disposable mail. Model providers, training use, prompt retention and summary accuracy were not established by the AI help read; general privacy marketing does not settle them.
sections.zh:
撰写指南根据提示、格式、语气及长度生成文本，Use It 在发送前把内容插入编辑器。在假设客户回复中，应对照真实对话核查姓名、承诺、日期及附件再批准；生成不证明答案正确，也不表示已发送。

AI Feed 则汇总未读消息，提供标记已读、归档及移入废纸篓，包括批量操作。其明确撤销说明针对标记已读，并通过短暂横幅操作；不能视为任意删除都可逆的保证。当摘要可能影响客户承诺时，应阅读原信，并用可丢弃邮件评估批量操作。已读 AI 帮助未确立模型服务商、训练使用、提示保留及摘要准确率；一般隐私宣传不能解决这些问题。

sections.title_en: Mail delivery, domain verification and client authorization differ
sections.title_zh: 区分投递、域名验证及客户端授权
sections.en:
Spike’s domains page says it hosts email rather than websites, and that externally registered domains keep their full DNS controls at the registrar. Its verification guidance discusses MX, SPF and DKIM changes, a Pending/Active state and checks for up to 48 hours. Treat zero-downtime migration language as a vendor claim, not a completed cutover test.

For a proposed hosting change, retain a known-working mail route and usable copy until sending, receiving and authentication have been evaluated. No DNS change was made. For existing mail accounts, the security FAQ distinguishes OAuth-supported connections, where Spike says it does not store the provider password, from non-OAuth connections with encrypted passwords. Email, calendar, contacts and cloud permissions have different purposes. Confirm the actual provider/tenant authentication policy rather than applying a generic old app-password troubleshooting guide to every Microsoft account. No consent or access grant was made.
sections.zh:
Spike 域名页称其托管邮件而非网站，外部注册域名的完整 DNS 控制仍在注册商。验证说明涉及 MX、SPF、DKIM 变更、Pending／Active 状态及最多48小时检查。“零停机迁移”应作为厂商主张，不是已完成的切换测试。

假设更换托管，应在评估发送、接收及认证前保留已知可用邮件路径与可用副本；本研究未改 DNS。对于现有邮箱，安全 FAQ 区分支持 OAuth 的连接（厂商称不存服务商密码），与使用加密密码的非 OAuth 连接。邮件、日历、联系人及云权限用途不同。应确认实际服务商／租户认证政策，不能把较旧通用应用密码排查套到所有 Microsoft 账户。本研究未执行同意或访问授权。

sections.title_en: Compare the two price tables using the intended service
sections.title_zh: 按目标服务比较两套价格表
sections.en:
Displayed annual rates are Teamspace Team 4 USD/member/month and Business 8; Email App Pro 6 USD/user/month and Ultimate 12. Teamspace Starter is free for up to 3 members with 15 GB/member; Email App Free connects one address and lists 1 GB for notes/tasks. Search is limited to 60 days on free tiers; that is a search boundary, not a stated deletion schedule.

A hypothetical four-member Teamspace Team subscription implies 192 USD/year before taxes or extras. The annual custom-domain offer covers one year, not perpetual renewal. The domains page still says five free users, conflicting with the current three-member pricing table. Recording and SAML SSO are marked SOON, so neither is treated as delivered. Checkout, monthly rates and final eligibility were not tested.
sections.zh:
显示的年付折算价为 Teamspace Team 每成员每月4美元、Business 8美元；Email App Pro 每用户每月6美元、Ultimate 12美元。Teamspace Starter 免费，最多3成员、每成员15GB；Email App Free 连接一个地址，笔记／任务列1GB。免费级搜索限60天，这是搜索边界，不是已声明的数据删除周期。

假设四成员订阅 Teamspace Team，税及额外费用前为每年192美元。年付自定义域名优惠只覆盖一年，不是永久免费续费。域名页仍称五名免费用户，与当前三成员价格表冲突。录制及 SAML SSO 标记 SOON，均不视为已交付。本研究未测试结账、月付价或最终资格。

sections.title_en: Cancellation, refund and the service license are separate questions
sections.title_zh: 分别核对取消、退款及服务许可
sections.en:
Billing help says personal annual subscriptions can receive a prorated refund within 14 days of initial purchase, excluding renewals; monthly plans are non-refundable. It separately lists Teamspace Team/Business+ as non-refundable. That older Business+ name should not silently be treated as a complete description of every current order. Confirm the applicable contract. The replacement-seat procedure removes the old user before adding another to avoid an additional charge; membership and paid-seat management both need verification.

The January 2025 public user terms grant a revocable, limited personal/noncommercial license and reserve source/distribution rights, while current marketing sells business services. The applicable business license needs clarification; this research does not resolve that mismatch. Open-source component exceptions do not make the full service open source, and hosted business email does not establish a self-hosted edition. No subscription, seat or agreement was changed.
sections.zh:
计费帮助称，个人年费在首次购买14天内可按比例退款，不适用于续订；月费不退。它另把 Teamspace Team／Business+ 列为不退款。较旧 Business+ 名称不能无声地作为所有当前订单的完整描述，应确认适用合同。席位替换流程要求先移除旧用户再添加新人，以免增加费用；成员与付费席位管理均需验证。

2025年1月公开用户条款授予可撤销的有限个人／非商业许可，保留源代码和分发权，而当前营销销售企业服务。适用商业许可需澄清，本研究不裁定此不一致。开源组件例外不让整个服务成为开源，托管企业邮件也不证明存在自行托管版。本研究未改变订阅、席位或协议。

sections.title_en: Retain an exit copy and verify the obligations for real mail
sections.title_zh: 保留退出副本，核对真实邮件的使用条件
sections.en:
Spike’s terms describe temporary server copies of provider email, while its privacy policy permits purpose-based account and legally necessary retention. Neither establishes a uniform purge interval for hosted mail, notes, shared files and AI inputs. Likewise, encryption and a dated audit statement do not prove an end-to-end model, a current independent assurance or a tested recovery target.

Spike merits evaluation when conversational email and lightweight shared work suit the team’s actual permissions and provider constraints. Before adopting it as a primary business mailbox, verify domain ownership/renewal, export of mail and collaboration artifacts, former-member access, provider revocation and recovery. Institutions requiring immutable retention, detailed audit or guaranteed restoration need evidence beyond the pages read. No mailbox export, cancellation, restore or real delivery test was executed.
sections.zh:
Spike 条款描述服务商邮件的临时服务器副本，隐私政策则允许按账户目的及法律需要保留。两者均未确立托管邮件、笔记、共享文件及 AI 输入统一的清除周期。同样，加密及注明年代的审计声明，不证明端到端模型、当前独立保证或经过测试的恢复目标。

当对话邮件与轻量共享工作符合实际权限和服务商条件时，可评估 Spike。采用为主要企业邮箱前，应核对域名所有权／续费、邮件及协作产物导出、离职成员访问、服务商撤销及恢复。需要不可变保留、详细审计或保证恢复的机构，需取得超出已读页面的证据。本研究未执行邮箱导出、取消、恢复或真实投递测试。

seo.description_zh: 结合托管与连接邮箱、邮件责任分配、笔记权限、AI 操作、年付费用及未解决的企业许可／恢复条款评估 Spike。

What should happen when a Note says changes are not saved?
